blocks.heading: Historical sales coverage
blocks.body: 4 September 2016 to 3 September 2018. All source statuses are included. Sales exclude freight; gross includes it. The first and last months are partial. 775 paid orders without items are outside this dashboard. Chart selections filter all pages; clear them to return to the full dataset.

pages.name: Markets and payments
pages.subtitle: Where did orders come from, and how were they paid?

blocks.heading: Explore regional demand
blocks.body: The state sales chart shows the top ten regions and drills into customer cities. Primary payment type is the method contributing the largest amount to each order, not a split of payment value. Product and seller detail remains in the item dataset.

Order-level measures
blocks.body: Every order contributes once. Missing reviews and delivery dates are excluded from their averages, rather than treated as zero. Review scores are already averaged across review records within an order. Delivery duration is measured from purchase to delivery.
